analyst_view.overall: Early view: Erzurum, back in the top flight after six years, started well but have lost their last two, while 5th-placed Kasimpasa have lost once in 11 games. Kasimpasa are adjusting to a new coach, Alfred Schreuder, who replaced Emre Belozoglu on 4 November after Belozoglu left for Fenerbahce. That change is the main unknown a month out.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean lower: Erzurum have scored only 10 in 11 games and coach Serkan Ozbalta says they play on quick counters rather than holding the ball. Kasimpasa's games average about 2.5 goals, and a side settling under a new coach is often careful early on.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners. Erzurum's counter-attacking approach does not produce long spells of pressure, and nothing in the news points to a change in either side's width, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. There is no referee yet and no derby or bad-blood angle between these two, so I have nothing to move the figure; this is one to recheck once the referee is named.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.3 shots. With Erzurum happy to sit and break and Kasimpasa still learning Schreuder's ideas, I expect a slightly more cautious game than the model sees.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.7 shots on target. Erzurum's low scoring rate (under a goal a game) suggests they do not test keepers often, so I lean a touch lower.
